_about: What sits between the backdrop and the boy (z: behind) or in front of him (z: front). Layer order, bottom to top: backdrop layers, props behind, the boy, props in front, then the on-screen text. Props are OFF in the default look; switch one on with "enabled": true, or try a scene without editing this file: --scene my-scene.json.

props._hint: A floor mat under the lying exercises. 'pad' is extra width on each side as a fraction of the boy's width.
A soft shadow under the boy. The generator's own shadow is keyed out, so this puts a consistent one back.
Any transparent PNG. x is the horizontal centre as a fraction of the frame; it stands on the ground line.
